items.title: A Complexity-Theoretic Approach to Proofs of Space
items.summary: A Proof of Space, PoS, as introduced by Dziembowski et al. [CRYPTO'15], is a two-phase protocol that enables a Prover to convince an efficient Verifier that it has allocated a large amount of persistent memory to storing some information. To our knowledge, all existing PoS protocols are only known to be secure in the random oracle model (or under ad hoc assumptions about cryptographic assumptions). We provide an elementary framework for constructing PoS from a combination of derandomization assumptions and cryptographic assumptions. We provide a few simple instantiations of the framework. We show that non-trivial PoS follow from (a) $\mathsf{E}=\mathsf{DTIME[2^{O(n)}]}$ is hard for exponential-size nondeterministic circuits (an assumption introduced to show $\mathsf{AM}=\mathsf{NP}$), and (b) collision-resistant hash functions. We also show that PoS with nearly optimal parameters and interaction pattern follows from assumption (a) above and (c) SNARGs for $\mathsf{P}$.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于复杂度理论构建空间证明（Proof of Space, PoS）协议的通用框架。空间证明由Dziembowski等人于CRYPTO 2015引入，是一种两阶段协议，允许证明者向验证者证明其已分配大量持久内存来存储特定信息。现有PoS协议的安全性通常依赖于随机预言机模型或专门的密码学假设。作者的目标是减少对随机预言机的依赖，转向更基础的复杂度理论和密码学假设。他们构建了一个简洁的框架，将去随机化假设（derandomization assumptions）与密码学假设相结合，并给出了几个简单的实例化。具体而言，他们证明：在假设(a) E=DTIME[2^{O(n)}] 对指数规模的非确定性电路困难（该假设曾用于证明AM=NP）以及(b) 抗碰撞哈希函数存在的前提下，可以构造非平凡的PoS。进一步，若再结合(c) 针对P的SNARG（简洁非交互式论证），则可构造具有近乎最优参数和交互模式的PoS。该工作为空间证明的设计提供了新的理论途径，减少了传统随机预言机模型的过度依赖。适合理论密码学、复杂度理论以及区块链/存储证明相关领域的研究者阅读。

items.title: IoXT: The Internet of Explainable Things. Why Explainability in IoT Requires a New System-Level Paradigm and Protocol Design
items.summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) increasingly combines sensing, communication, artificial intelligence (AI), decision-making, and actuation. In many domains, sensor observations are processed by edge or cloud intelligence to select actions that configure or control actuators; where actuation changes the environment, later observations may also be affected. Existing explainable AI (XAI) methods can explain model predictions, but they do not by themselves explain the end-to-end path from sensed evidence to physical action. This paper introduces the Internet of Explainable Things (IoXT), a system-level paradigm that makes explainability an architectural property of intelligent IoT. Its novelty is explainability-by-design across the sensing-communication-intelligence-decision-actuation path. IoXT derives requirements and design principles for identity and addressability, temporal fidelity, cross-layer provenance, bidirectional traceability, streaming and incident-time evidence, protocol-semantic continuity, security and privacy, lifecycle continuity, and conformance. We formalize timestamped provenance graphs, sensor participation, trace completeness, cross-layer coverage, reconstruction latency, and No Orphan Actuation: a consequential action must remain traceable to the authorizing decision and source evidence, or be explicitly marked degraded or non-conformant. IoXT prescribes neither a particular XAI method nor a wire protocol. Instead, it defines the conditions under which model explanations remain connected to real sensor inputs, communication history, decisions, actuator execution, and outcomes. Explainability Telemetry Protocols (XTPs) are introduced as a protocol category for preserving these semantics across heterogeneous IoT systems, together with IoXT-ready and IoXT-conformant assurance concepts.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出“可解释物联网（IoXT）”这一系统级新范式。传统物联网系统将感知、通信、人工智能（AI）决策与执行器控制相结合，但现有的可解释AI（XAI）方法只能解释模型自身的预测，无法完整解释从传感器证据到物理动作的端到端因果路径。IoXT的核心创新在于将可解释性作为智能IoT的架构属性来设计，贯穿“感知-通信-智能-决策-执行”全链路。作者系统性地推导了IoXT的需求与设计原则，涵盖身份与可寻址性、时间保真度、跨层来源追踪、双向可追溯性、流式与事件时刻证据、协议语义连续性、安全与隐私、生命周期连续性和一致性等方面。文中形式化了时间戳来源图、传感器参与度、轨迹完整性、跨层覆盖、重建延迟等概念，并提出了“无孤立执行”原则：任何关键动作必须可追溯到授权决策和源证据，否则必须被明确标记为降级或不合规。IoXT不指定某种具体XAI方法或特定线协议，而是定义模型解释与现实传感器输入、通信历史、决策、执行器执行和结果保持关联的边界条件。论文还引入了“可解释性遥测协议（XTP）”作为一类协议，用于在不同IoT系统间保持这些语义，并定义了IoXT-ready和IoXT-conformant两类保证概念。本文适合从事物联网安全、可解释AI、系统架构设计以及合规审计的研究者和工程师阅读，为构建可审计、可追溯的智能物理系统提供理论框架。

items.title: Differential Privacy for Markov Chain State Trajectories
items.summary: Data-driven systems may require state trajectories of Markov chains to function because these trajectories contain information that is useful to the system, e.g., a product's credit risk, a user's physical location, or a user's internet browsing behavior. However, sharing such state trajectories can reveal sensitive information about users, which presents a privacy threat. Therefore, we develop a new framework for privatizing the state trajectories in a Markov chain using differential privacy. Our framework privatizes state trajectories online, in the sense that a private state trajectory is generated at the same time as the sensitive one it approximates. We treat Markov chains as weighted directed graphs whose edge weights are the negative logarithms of the transition probabilities. Then, each state in a private state trajectory is chosen by minimizing its distance to the corresponding state in the sensitive state trajectory, where the notion of distance is equal to the total edge weight along a shortest path. We prove that with high probability the private state trajectory remains close to the sensitive one, which maintains high utility for downstream uses of private data. Additionally, we prove that private state trajectories are consistently in the typical set of state trajectories generated by the underlying Markov chain, which means that private state trajectories have similar statistical properties to actual state trajectories produced by the underlying Markov chain. Numerical simulations show that under $3$-differential privacy, the mechanism we introduce exhibits up to an $80\%$ decrease in entropy compared to the state of the art, which illustrates that private state trajectories generated by our framework more closely resemble their corresponding sensitive state trajectory while maintaining the same level of privacy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对数据驱动系统中马尔可夫链状态轨迹的隐私泄露问题，提出了一种基于差分隐私的在线隐私化框架。在许多应用中，系统需要依赖马尔可夫链的状态轨迹（如产品信用风险、用户物理位置、上网行为等）进行决策，但这些轨迹往往包含敏感的用户信息。现有方法通常需要离线处理或会引入较大噪声，导致数据效用下降。为此，作者将马尔可夫链建模为加权有向图，边的权重取转移概率的负对数，并将隐私化轨迹中的每个状态定义为与原始敏感状态在最短路径总权重（即距离）上最接近的候选状态。该机制以在线方式工作，即在生成敏感轨迹的同时生成对应的隐私轨迹，无需等待完整轨迹。理论上，作者证明了隐私轨迹以高概率保持与敏感轨迹接近，从而在下游任务中维持高效用；同时，隐私轨迹始终处于原马尔可夫链的典型集内，说明其统计特性与真实轨迹相似。数值实验表明，在 3-差分隐私参数下，所提机制相比现有技术可将熵降低高达 80%，意味着生成的隐私轨迹更接近原始敏感轨迹，且保持相同隐私水平。本文的主要贡献包括：首次针对马尔可夫链状态轨迹提出在线差分隐私框架、基于加权图距离的隐私化机制、以及严格的理论保证和实验验证。适合对差分隐私、马尔可夫链建模和数据驱动隐私保护感兴趣的研究人员阅读。

items.title: A Blueprint for Collaborative Cybersecurity Operations Centres with Capacity for Shared Situational Awareness, Coordinated Response, and Joint Preparedness
items.summary: With digital technologies now being part of the fabric of our societies, identifying and managing cybersecurity threats becomes imperative. Within the European Union, several initiatives are underway, aiming to motivate, regulate and eventually orchestrate the establishment of capacity and enhancement of situational awareness, incident response, and preparedness capabilities, with an expected emphasis on operators of essential services and state actors entrusted with cybersecurity. In this context, the institution of cooperation and information exchange channels to allow for coordinated cross-border responses to large-scale incidents is particularly prioritised. Motivated by the above, this work presents a conceptual blueprint in support of architecting and establishing interoperable Cyber Security Operations Centres that combine capacity for situational awareness, incident response, and preparedness, also benefiting from the interplay between them, ultimately enhancing national cybersecurity capabilities, cross-border collaboration, and national supervision of their critical sectors, in line with current and upcoming regulatory requirements and the ever-increasing need for national and international cooperation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着数字技术融入社会方方面面，识别和管理网络安全威胁变得至关重要。在欧盟内部，多项倡议正在推进，旨在激励、规范并最终协调网络安全能力的建设，提升态势感知、事件响应和应急准备能力，尤其关注重要服务运营商和承担网络安全职责的国家行为体。在此背景下，建立合作与信息交换渠道，以实现大规模跨境事件的协调响应，成为优先事项。针对这一需求，本文提出了一份概念蓝图，用于支撑设计和建立可互操作的网络安全运营中心（Cyber Security Operations Centres, CSOC）。该蓝图所描述的 CSOC 综合了态势感知、事件响应和应急准备三种能力，并强调三者之间的协同效应，从而增强国家网络安全能力、促进跨境协作，并强化国家对关键部门的监督。这一设计旨在适应当前及未来的监管要求，并满足日益增长的国家与国际合作需要。论文主要贡献在于：提供了一个系统化的架构蓝图，将分散的安全运营能力整合为协作式、可互操作的运营中心；提出了共享态势感知、协调响应和联合准备的具体机制；并展示了如何将上述概念落地，以支持欧盟范围内的网络安全协同。对于参与国家级网络安全建设、CSOC 设计以及跨境合作机制研究的人员，本文具有参考价值。

items.title: Strategies to Avoid Illegal Data Access
items.summary: For companies of all sizes, data security is a top priority. The chance of unauthorized data access increases as technology develops. To prevent unwanted access to their data, businesses must be proactive. This study examines technology solutions, personnel training, and policy enforcement as methods to prevent unauthorized data access. Data may be protected from illegal access using technological solutions like firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and encryption. Intrusion detection systems notify the administrator when suspicious behavior is found, while firewalls serve as a protective border between the internal network and the internet. Even if data is intercepted, encryption makes sure it is safe. Another effective method of avoiding unauthorized data access is employee education. Employees must be taught how to spot hazards like phishing emails and shady websites and react to them. Additionally, they should be taught the right way to utilize passwords and other security precautions. To secure data, organizations should create and implement policies. Policies should set out appropriate data and system use guidelines and provide repercussions for noncompliance. Policies should be evaluated regularly to ensure that they are current and useful. Businesses may prevent unwanted access to their data by installing technology solutions, training staff, and enforcing regulations. Organizations may reduce data breach risk and maintain regulatory compliance by taking these precautions. ...

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇关于企业防止非法数据访问的策略性综述研究。随着技术发展，未授权数据访问的风险持续上升，企业必须采取主动防御措施来保护敏感数据。论文从三个维度系统分析了防止未授权访问的方法：技术解决方案、员工培训和制度政策执行。在技术层面，重点介绍了防火墙、入侵检测系统和加密技术。防火墙作为内部网络与互联网之间的安全边界，能够过滤恶意流量；入侵检测系统在发现可疑行为时能够实时告警管理员；加密技术则确保即使数据被截获，也无法被未授权方解读。在员工培训方面，论文强调人的因素在数据安全中的关键作用，指出员工需要能够识别钓鱼邮件、恶意网站等常见威胁，并掌握正确的密码使用习惯及安全操作规范。在政策执行层面，组织应当制定并落实恰当的数据与系统使用指导原则，明确规定违规行为的后果，并定期审查政策以确保其时效性和有效性。论文认为，通过综合运用技术、人员和制度三大手段，企业能够显著降低数据泄露风险，并满足合规要求。本文主要面向企业安全管理者、信息安全工程师以及负责数据治理的决策者，为其构建多层次防御体系提供了理论框架和实践参考。

items.summary: Sub2API is an AI API gateway platform designed to distribute and manage API quotas from AI product subscriptions. From 0.1.135, to 0.1.168, platform API keys issued to tenants are exchanged for upstream requests made with shared provider accounts (ChatGPT/Codex OAuth, OpenAI platform keys, or an operator-configured base URL) that belong to the operator, not to the caller. The `POST /responses/*subpath` wildcard routes spliced the client-supplied subpath into the upstream URL with no validation. This lets an authenticated tenant relay requests to arbitrary upstream endpoints using pooled account credentials via a path traversal. This vulnerability is fixed in 0.1.169.

items.summary: n8n before 2.32.1 (and before 2.31.5) is vulnerable to account takeover via the Token Exchange Embed Login feature. When a validly-signed incoming token was matched to a local account by its email claim, the service did not verify that the email claim was verified, nor that the trusted key's permitted role ceiling covered that account. As a result, anyone able to obtain a token accepted by a configured trusted key (for example, a trusted issuer emitting unverified email addresses) could authenticate as any existing user and gain full account control. This issue only affects instances where the embed login feature is enabled and at least one trusted key source is configured.

items.title: The Realtek BEE Bluetooth HCI driver's send callback, bt_hci_bee_send() in drivers/bluetooth/hci/hci_bee.c, violated the bt_hci_driver_api buffer-ownership contract. That contra...
items.summary:
The Realtek BEE Bluetooth HCI driver's send callback, bt_hci_bee_send() in drivers/bluetooth/hci/hci_bee.c, violated the bt_hci_driver_api buffer-ownership contract. That contract requires the driver to consume (unref) the transmit net_buf only on success; on an error return the host caller retains ownership and unrefs the buffer itself. The pre-fix code routed all error paths through a shared cleanup label that unconditionally called net_buf_unref(buf) before returning the error code.

Because the host TX paths (in subsys/bluetooth/host/hci_core.c) unref the buffer again after send() returns an error, the buffer is freed twice: the driver returns it to its net_buf pool and the host then unrefs the already-freed buffer, corrupting the shared pool / underflowing the reference count (CWE-415). The same error branch additionally dereferenced buf->len inside a LOG_ERR call after the buffer had already been unref'd, a read of freed memory (CWE-416) that is compiled in at the default error log level.

The failing edges are reached when the controller's host-to-controller buffer allocation fails or the controller send fails (resource-exhaustion / IO conditions). A remote Bluetooth peer can push the device toward these conditions indirectly by driving heavy host transmit activity, at which point the double-free corrupts the host net_buf pool and most likely crashes the device, with residual potential for further memory corruption. The impact is confined to builds using this specific Realtek BEE HCI driver.

The fix returns early from each error path without unreffing and unrefs the buffer only on the success path, restoring the ownership contract and eliminating both the double-free and the use-after-free read.

items.summary: TypeBot is a chatbot builder tool. Versions prior to 3.17.0 allow a low-privilege read collaborator to extract a workspace OAuth `credentialsId` from a readable bot configuration and then overwrite that credential through `handleUpdateOAuthCredentials()` by supplying an attacker-controlled writable `workspaceId`. The update path validates only the attacker-supplied workspace and then updates the credential record by global `id` alone, while also rewriting the credential's `workspaceId`. This allows cross-workspace OAuth credential takeover and reassignment. Version 3.17.0 patches the issue.

items.summary: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system. Prior to 4.24, VolumeServer.FetchAndWriteNeedle in weed/server/volume_grpc_remote.go fetches a caller-supplied remote endpoint through weed/remote_storage/s3/s3_storage_client.go and writes the response into a needle. The RPC performs no authentication and no target validation, allowing anyone who can reach a volume server's gRPC port to cause requests to arbitrary hosts, including loopback, link-local, RFC 1918, and cloud metadata endpoints such as 169.254.169.254, and read the response. On cloud deployments, this can disclose instance metadata and IAM credentials and reach otherwise unexposed internal services. The volume server gRPC plane is unauthenticated by default, and configuring documented JWT signing keys does not protect this RPC. This issue is fixed in version 4.24.

drm/vc4: Prevent shader BO...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/vc4: Prevent shader BO mappings from becoming writable

vc4_gem_object_mmap() rejects a writable mapping of a validated shader
BO, but leaves VM_MAYWRITE set.  Userspace can map the BO read-only and
then turn it writable with mprotect().

Validated shader BOs must stay read-only: the validator checks the
instructions once and the GPU trusts them afterwards.  A writable
mapping lets userspace rewrite the code after validation, bypassing the
validator.

Clear VM_MAYWRITE on the read-only path so the mapping cannot be
upgraded, as i915 already does for its read-only objects.

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

btrfs: don't propagate...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

btrfs: don't propagate EXTENT_FLAG_LOGGING to split extent maps

When btrfs_drop_extent_map_range() splits an extent map, the new split
maps inherit the original map's flags through a local 'flags' variable.
Commit f86f7a75e2fb ("btrfs: use the flags of an extent map to identify
the compression type") changed the EXTENT_FLAG_LOGGING clearing to
operate on em->flags instead of that local 'flags' copy, so a split of
an extent map that is currently being logged wrongly inherits
EXTENT_FLAG_LOGGING.

The flag is then never cleared on the split, and when it is freed while
still on the inode's modified_extents list (for example by the extent
map shrinker) it trips the WARN_ON(!list_empty(&em->list)) in
btrfs_free_extent_map() and leads to a use-after-free.

Clear EXTENT_FLAG_LOGGING from the local 'flags' copy used for the
splits and only clear EXTENT_FLAG_PINNED from em->flags, restoring the
behaviour prior to f86f7a75e2fb.

firmware: arm_ffa: Fix NULL...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

firmware: arm_ffa: Fix NULL dereference in ffa_partition_info_get()

ffa_partition_info_get() passes uuid_str directly to uuid_parse()
without a NULL check. When a caller passes NULL, uuid_parse() ->
__uuid_parse() -> uuid_is_valid() dereferences the pointer, causing
a kernel panic:

  |  Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at virtual address
  |  0000000000000040
  |  pc : uuid_parse+0x40/0xac
  |  lr : ffa_partition_info_get+0x1c/0x94 [arm_ffa]

Add a NULL guard before uuid_parse() so a NULL argument returns
-ENODEV instead of crashing. Callers are expected to always supply
a valid partition UUID, so NULL is not a supported input.

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

hwmon: (gigabyte_waterforce) Stop device IO before calling hid_hw_stop

Calling hid_hw_stop() does not stop the device IO.
This results in a race condition between hid_input_report() and the point
immediately following the execution of hid_device_io_start() within
the driver probe function. If the probe operation fails after "io start"
has been initiated, this race condition will result in a UAF vulnerability.

Fix the problem by calling hid_device_io_stop() before calling
hid_hw_stop().

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/imagination: Fit paired...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/imagination: Fit paired fragment job in the correct CCCB

For geometry jobs with a paired fragment job, at the moment, the
DRM scheduler's prepare_job() callback:

- checks for internal (driver) dependencies for the geometry job;
- calls into pvr_queue_get_paired_frag_job_dep() to check for external
  dependencies for the fragment job (the two jobs are submitted together
  but the common scheduler code doesn't know about it, so this needs to
  be done at this point in time);
- calls into the prepare_job() callback again, but for the fragment job,
  to check its internal dependencies as well, passing the fragment job's
  drm_sched_job and the geometry job's drm_sched_entity / pvr_queue.

The problem with the last step is that pvr_queue_prepare_job() doesn't
always take the mismatched fragment job and geometry queue into account,
in particular when checking whether there is space for the fragment
command to be submitted, so the code ends up checking for space in the
geometry (i.e. wrong) CCCB.
The rest of the nested prepare_job() callback happens to work fine at
the moment as the other internal dependencies are not relevant for a
paired fragment job.

Move the initialisation of a paired fragment job's done fence and CCCB

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

libceph: bound get_version...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

libceph: bound get_version reply decode to front len

handle_get_version_reply() uses msg->front_alloc_len as the decode
boundary for MON_GET_VERSION_REPLY.  That is the size of the reused
reply buffer, not the number of bytes actually received.

A truncated reply can therefore pass ceph_decode_need() and decode the
second u64 from stale tail bytes left in the buffer by an earlier
message, causing an uninitialized memory read.

Use msg->front.iov_len as the receive-side decode boundary, matching
other libceph reply handlers and limiting decoding to the bytes that
were actually read from the wire.

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

vxlan: require CAP_NET_ADMIN...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

vxlan: require CAP_NET_ADMIN in the device netns for changelink

A tunnel changelink() operates on at most two netns, dev_net(dev) and
the sticky underlay netns vxlan->net. They differ once the device is
created in or moved to a netns other than the one the request runs in.
The rtnl changelink path checks CAP_NET_ADMIN only against dev_net(dev),
so a caller privileged there but not in vxlan->net can rewrite a vxlan
device whose underlay lives in vxlan->net.

vxlan_changelink() validates and applies the new configuration against
vxlan->net (vxlan_config_validate(vxlan->net, ...)) and can reopen the
underlay socket in that netns, so the same reasoning as the tunnel
changelink series applies here.

Gate vxlan_changelink() with rtnl_dev_link_net_capable(), at the top of
the op before any attribute is parsed, matching ipgre_changelink() and
the rest of the "require CAP_NET_ADMIN in the device netns for
changelink" series.

Found by 0sec automated security-research tooling (https://0sec.ai).

serial: 8250_mid: Fix NULL...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

serial: 8250_mid: Fix NULL function pointer dereference on DNV/ICX-D/SNR platforms

Commit b1b4efea05a5 ("serial: 8250_mid: Disable DMA for selected
platforms") replaced the dnv_board setup and exit callbacks with
PTR_IF(false, ...), which evaluates to NULL. However, the three call
sites in mid8250_probe() and mid8250_remove() unconditionally
dereference these function pointers without NULL checks, causing a NULL
pointer dereference (kernel oops) on any Denverton (DNV), Ice Lake Xeon
D (ICX-D/CDF), or Snowridge (SNR) platform.

Fix this by adding the missing NULL checks before calling the setup and
exit callbacks.

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/amd/display: use...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/amd/display: use kvzalloc to allocate struct dc

struct dc has grown large over time (most of it the two inlined
dc_scratch_space copies) and now sits close to the page allocator's 4 MiB
contiguous allocation limit. Its actual size is not fixed by the source
alone, it also depends on the compiler and the .config, so it can easily
cross 4 MiB, e.g. with a newer GCC or a config change.

dc_create() allocates it with kzalloc(). Once struct dc exceeds 4 MiB the
request is rounded up to order 11 (8 MiB), which is above MAX_PAGE_ORDER,
so the page allocator warns and returns NULL. dc_create() then fails, DM
init fails and amdgpu probe aborts with -EINVAL:

  WARNING: mm/page_alloc.c:5197 at __alloc_frozen_pages_noprof+0x2f9/0x380
   dc_create+0x38/0x660 [amdgpu]
   amdgpu_dm_init+0x2d9/0x510 [amdgpu]
   dm_hw_init+0x1b/0x90 [amdgpu]
   amdgpu_device_init.cold+0x150d/0x1e13 [amdgpu]
   amdgpu_driver_load_kms+0x19/0x80 [amdgpu]
   amdgpu_pci_probe+0x1e2/0x4c0 [amdgpu]

dc_create() then returns NULL and DM init fails, which aborts the whole
GPU init and makes amdgpu probe fail with -EINVAL ("hw_init of IP block
<dm> failed -22"), leaving the display unusable. The subsequent
amdgpu_irq_put() warnings during teardown are just fallout of unwinding
a half-initialized device.

struct dc is a software-only bookkeeping structure that is never handed
to hardware DMA and is only ever kept as an opaque pointer, so it does
not require physically contiguous memory. Allocate it with kvzalloc()
(and free it with kvfree()) so that the allocator can fall back to
vmalloc() when a contiguous allocation of that size is not available,
which also avoids the MAX_PAGE_ORDER warning entirely.

v2:
 - Rebase to amd-staging-drm-next.

(cherry picked from commit 991e0516a8072f2292681c6ae98a924ab0e32575)

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ksmbd: validate minimum PDU...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ksmbd: validate minimum PDU size for transform requests

The receive path applies the minimum SMB2 PDU size check only when
ProtocolId is SMB2_PROTO_NUMBER. A packet carrying
SMB2_TRANSFORM_PROTO_NUM bypasses the check even when the negotiated
dialect does not provide transform handling.

On an SMB 2.1 connection, a short transform packet therefore reaches
init_smb2_rsp_hdr(), which interprets the request as a full SMB2 header
and reads beyond the request allocation. The copied fields can then be
returned to the unauthenticated client.

Compression transforms are converted to ordinary SMB2 messages before
protocol validation. After that conversion, validate ordinary SMB2
requests against SMB2_MIN_SUPPORTED_PDU_SIZE and require encryption
transform requests to contain both a transform header and an SMB2
header. This rejects truncated requests before work allocation.

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net/sched: Handle...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net/sched: Handle TC_ACT_REDIRECT from qdisc filter chains

When a TC filter attached to a qdisc filter chain returns
TC_ACT_REDIRECT (ex: via an eBPF program calling bpf_redirect() or an
act_bpf action), the redirect was silently lost i.e no qdisc classify
function handled TC_ACT_REDIRECT, so the packet fell through the
switch and was enqueued normally instead of being redirected.

This has been broken since bpf_redirect() was introduced for TC in
commit 27b29f63058d ("bpf: add bpf_redirect() helper"). We got lucky
for a long time because bpf_net_context was a per-CPU variable that
was always available.

commit 401cb7dae813 ("net: Reference bpf_redirect_info via task_struct
on PREEMPT_RT.") turned bpf_net_context into a task_struct member that
is only set up by explicit callers. Without a caller setting it up,
bpf_redirect() itself crashes with a NULL pointer dereference in
bpf_net_ctx_get_ri(). However, even with bpf_net_context available,
TC_ACT_REDIRECT from qdisc filter chains cannot be honored without
adding skb_do_redirect() calls to every qdisc classify function, which
would require changes across net/sched/. Isolate it to ebpf core where
it belongs.

Instead, add a tcf_classify_qdisc() inline helper in pkt_cls.h, as a
wrapper around tcf_classify() for use by qdisc classify functions and
tcf_qevent_handle(). When the classify verdict is TC_ACT_REDIRECT,
the wrapper converts it to TC_ACT_SHOT, dropping the packet rather
than letting it continue silently. Dropping is preferred over
letting the packet through because the user immediately sees packet
loss. Silently passing the packet through would hide the problem and
leave the user wondering why their redirect is not working.

The clsact fast path, tc_run() continues to call tcf_classify() directly
and is unaffected: TC_ACT_REDIRECT is returned as-is and handled by
sch_handle_egress/ingress() calling skb_do_redirect() as before.

LoongArch: Fix address space...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

LoongArch: Fix address space mismatch in kexec command line lookup

When searching the loaded segments for the "kexec" command line marker,
the kexec_load(2) path (file_mode == 0) passes the user-space segment
buffer straight to strncmp() through a bogus (char __user *) cast. This
dereferences a user pointer in kernel context, which is wrong and is
flagged by sparse:

  arch/loongarch/kernel/machine_kexec.c:84:51: sparse: incorrect type in
  argument 2 (different address spaces) @@ expected char const * @@ got
  char [noderef] __user *

Here copy the marker-sized prefix of each segment into a small on-stack
buffer with copy_from_user() before comparing, and skip segments that
fault. The subsequent copy_from_user() that stages the full command line
into the safe area is left unchanged.

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/dp_mst: Handle torn-down...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/dp_mst: Handle torn-down topology gracefully in drm_dp_mst_topology_queue_probe()

A hotplug or link-loss event can tear down the MST topology
(setting mgr->mst_state = false and mgr->mst_primary = NULL) concurrently
with a caller invoking drm_dp_mst_topology_queue_probe(). Since the check
is already performed under mgr->lock, the condition is not a programming
error but a valid race -- the topology was valid when the caller decided
to call this function, but was torn down before the lock was acquired.

Replace the drm_WARN_ON() with a graceful early return. This eliminates
spurious kernel warnings and the resulting compositor crashes observed
when connecting/disconnecting DP MST monitors, while keeping the correct
behavior of doing nothing when MST is not active. A drm_dbg_mst() trace
is added so the skipped probe remains observable under MST debug logging.

The existing WARN_ON(mgr->mst_primary) in drm_dp_mst_topology_mgr_set_mst()
already catches the case where the topology is initialized twice, so no
diagnostic coverage is lost.

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

smp: Make CSD lock...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

smp: Make CSD lock acquisition atomic for debug mode

Commit b0473dcd4b1d ("smp: Improve smp_call_function_single()
CSD-lock diagnostics") changed smp_call_function_single() so that,
when CSD lock debugging is enabled, async !wait calls use the
destination CPU csd_data. That improves diagnostics, but it also removes
the single-writer property that made the old csd_lock() safe: multiple
CPUs can now prepare the same destination CPU CSD concurrently.

csd_lock() currently waits for CSD_FLAG_LOCK to clear and then sets the
bit with a non-atomic read-modify-write. Two senders can both see an
unlocked CSD, set the bit, overwrite the callback fields, and enqueue
the same llist node. Re-adding a node that is already the queue head can
make node->next point to itself, leaving the target CPU stuck walking
call_single_queue. Later synchronous work, such as a TLB shootdown, can
then remain queued and trigger soft-lockup warnings or panics.

Keep the single csd_lock() implementation, but when CSD lock debugging is
enabled, acquire CSD_FLAG_LOCK with try_cmpxchg_acquire(). This makes the
destination CPU CSD a real atomic lock in the only configuration where it
can be shared by multiple remote senders, while preserving the existing
non-debug fast path.

items.title: The AcyMailing – An Ultimate Newsletter Plugin and Marketing Automation Solution for WordPress...
items.summary: The AcyMailing – An Ultimate Newsletter Plugin and Marketing Automation Solution for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 10.11.1. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to overwrite the BCC field of the acy_notification_cms notification template, causing subsequent WordPress password-reset emails — including those targeting administrator accounts — to be silently copied to an attacker-controlled address, enabling account takeover via the captured reset link. Successful exploitation requires the site administrator to have enabled the "Send website emails with AcyMailing" option, which routes WordPress core notification emails through AcyMailing's templating system.

items.summary: ## Executive summary Microsoft is releasing this security advisory to provide information about a vulnerability in Windows Presentation Foundation. This advisory also provides guidance on what developers can do to update their applications to remove this vulnerability. A specially crafted document parsed in .NET can trigger the inclusion of functionality from an untrusted control sphere, allowing an unauthorized attacker to disclose information over a network. ## Announcement Announcement for this issue can be found at https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/433 ## CVSS Details - **Version:** 3.1 - **Severity:** Medium - **Score:** 6.5 - **Vector:** `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N/E:U/RL:O/RC:C` - **Weakness:** CWE-829: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere; CWE-693: Protection Mechanism Failure; CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) ## If using a package listed in [affected packages](#affected-packages), an application is exposed to the vulnerability. ### How do I fix the issue? 1. items.title: Activation Probes Surface Code-Security Signals that the Model's Output Misses
items.summary: AI coding agents now write a growing share of production code, and human security review does not scale at the rate code is generated. The agents in widest use are closed-weight, so a deploying team cannot read their internals. It can instead run an open-weight model as a reviewer over the agent's output. That reviewer's activations are readable. We ask whether reading those activations recovers a security signal that simply asking the same reviewer misses. We fit a single linear probe per model on a corpus of paired vulnerable-and-fixed Python functions, then test it without retraining on real disclosed vulnerabilities whose weakness type the probe never saw in training, across five open-weight reviewer models. On the vulnerabilities fixed by changing a single function, the probe scores the vulnerable function above its fix on 61-67% of cases for every model, beating the 50% chance line. It also beats the same model's prompted YES/NO win-rate read from its logits, under every prompt we try. Asking the model for a written verdict, even with chain-of-thought, returns the same answer on the vulnerable and fixed function most of the time and so cannot tell them apart. Model activations carry a code-security signal that prompting the same model misses.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究AI编码助手生成代码的安全审查问题。随着AI编码代理在生产代码中占比上升，人工安全审查难以跟上代码生成速度，且主流代理多为闭源模型，部署团队无法读取其内部结构。作者提出改用开源权重模型作为审查器，对代理输出进行安全复核，并进一步探索：读取该审查模型的激活值（activation）是否能捕捉到仅通过提示（prompt）无法获得的安全信号。方法上，作者在成对的易受攻击/修复后Python函数语料上，为每个模型训练一个线性探针（linear probe），然后在未见过的真实已披露漏洞（其弱点类型在训练中从未出现）上测试，涉及五个开源审查模型。结果显示：对于单函数修复的漏洞，探针在61-67%的案例中能正确将易受攻击函数排在修复版本之上，优于50%随机基线；并且在不同提示设置下，均优于同一模型基于logits的YES/NO判别准确率。而直接让模型给出书面判断（即使使用思维链）在多数情况下对易受攻击与修复版本返回相同答案，无法区分。结论是模型激活值携带了一种提示词所缺失的代码安全信号。该研究适用于对AI生成代码安全评估感兴趣的安全研究人员、AI安全工程师及模型可解释性研究者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为AI代码生成安全审查提供了新思路：无需白盒访问生成模型，仅利用开源审查模型的内部激活即可提升漏洞检出能力，弥补了纯文本提示审查的盲区。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于AI辅助代码审查流水线，作为现有LLM审阅器的补充信号；对构建鲁棒的AI代码安全检测机制具有参考价值。

items.title: Once Poisoned, Arbitrarily Controlled: A Programmable Backdoor in VLMs
items.summary: Existing vision-language model (VLM) backdoors are usually treated as static vulnerabilities: one-to-one and N-to-N attacks bind one or more triggers to a finite set of targets before victim training. This assumption substantially underestimates the threat. We show that a single poisoning phase can implant a programmable backdoor into a VLM, allowing an attacker to choose previously unseen target-caption semantics at inference time and synthesize corresponding stealthy triggers on demand. Unlike fixed-mapping attacks, the proposed any-to-any caption-control paradigm decouples post-training target selection from poisoning, enabling dynamic control of target captions without retraining the VLM. Our method has two components. First, a heuristic poisoning strategy exposes the model to diverse trigger-caption pairs, encouraging it to learn a general trigger-as-instruction rule rather than memorize a specific backdoor pattern. Second, a feature-space trigger steganography method maps any attacker-specified target caption to a stealthy visual trigger, implemented as either a norm-controlled perturbation or a non-semantic patch. Once inserted into arbitrary images, these triggers cause the poisoned VLM to generate outputs semantically aligned with the chosen target caption, even when the target was unseen during poisoning. Extensive experiments show that our attack achieves high any-to-any caption-control success rates, preserves clean model utility, and remains effective under several classical backdoor defenses.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）中的后门攻击，提出了一种可编程后门方案，突破了传统静态后门仅能建立固定触发-目标映射的限制。在传统攻击中，攻击者在训练阶段将特定触发器与固定目标绑定，受害者模型只能执行预设的映射。本文则通过单一投毒阶段，让攻击者在推理时任意选择目标字幕语义，并按需合成相应触发器，无需重新训练即可动态控制模型输出。方法包含两个核心组件：启发式投毒策略，使模型接触多样化的触发-字幕对，从而学习通用的“触发器即指令”规则；以及特征空间触发隐写技术，将攻击者指定的目标字幕映射为隐蔽视觉触发器，形式可为范数受控扰动或非语义块。一旦插入任意图像，触发器会促使中毒模型生成与目标字幕语义一致的结果，即使目标在投毒阶段未出现过。实验表明该攻击实现了高成功率，保持干净模型效用，并能抵抗多种经典后门防御。该工作重新定义了 VLM 后门攻击的威胁模型，提示蓝队需关注动态可控后门风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 此类可编程后门使攻击者拥有按需生成任意目标的能力，极大提升了 VLM 后门的灵活性和隐蔽性，且能规避静态防御，对依赖 VLM 的产业应用构成潜在风险，需引起防御方警惕。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对使用 VLM 的内容生成、视觉问答、辅助驾驶等场景均存在潜在影响；攻击不依赖训练后微调，可动态改变模型行为，增加防御难度。
detection_signals_zh: 模型输出与输入语义出现明显不符的异常情况
输入图像中存在可疑的隐蔽扰动或非语义补丁
相同或类似触发器在不同目标间出现可复现的映射关系
defense_advice_zh: 采用鲁棒投毒防御方法，如数据清洗、异常样本过滤和差分隐私
部署输入预处理模块，检测图像中的异常扰动或补丁
在模型集成前评估对未知触发器的敏感性，并进行针对性鲁棒化训练
持续监控模型输出分布，发现异常关联时及时告警

items.summary: A flaw was found in the multicloud-operators-channel component of Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management (RHACM). This vulnerability allows a compromised agent from a managed cluster to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information. Specifically, the agent can read all Secrets and ConfigMaps within any Channel namespace on the hub, potentially exposing credentials for other tenants' Git and Helm repositories. This could lead to significant information disclosure.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-73122 是 Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management (RHACM) 中 multicloud-operators-channel 组件的一个漏洞。该漏洞允许受感染的受管集群代理未经授权读取 Hub 上任意 Channel 命名空间内的所有 Secrets 和 ConfigMaps，进而可能泄露其他租户 Git 和 Helm 仓库的凭据，造成严重的信息泄露。CVSS 评分为 7.7（CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:N/A:N），属于高严重性漏洞，攻击复杂度低，需要低权限，无需用户交互，且影响范围可跨越安全边界，对机密性造成高影响。目前 EPSS 数据未提供，该漏洞尚未列入 KEV 目录，也未被标记为在野利用。由于受影响产品和厂商信息未提供，建议红帽用户密切关注官方安全公告，及时应用补丁或更新，同时限制相关组件网络暴露面，并加强日志监控，以防敏感信息泄露。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致跨租户凭据泄露，直接影响 RHACM 管理的多集群环境安全，需优先处置并限制网络访问。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 受管集群代理可读取 Hub 上所有 Channel 命名空间的 Secrets 和 ConfigMaps，造成其他租户 Git/Helm 凭据泄露，严重破坏机密性。

items.summary: A flaw was found in multicloud-operators-subscription. A privileged user, specifically a namespace administrator capable of creating Channel and Subscription resources, can exploit this vulnerability. By manipulating the Channel.Spec.SecretRef.Namespace field, the user can cause the system to copy sensitive Secret contents from other namespaces into their own, leading to information disclosure.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66878 是 multicloud-operators-subscription 组件中的一个信息泄露漏洞。该组件通常用于 OpenShift 或 Kubernetes 环境中的多集群订阅管理。漏洞的核心在于：具备命名空间管理员权限的用户（能够创建 Channel 和 Subscription 资源）可以通过操纵 Channel.Spec.SecretRef.Namespace 字段，将原本位于其他命名空间中的敏感 Secret 内容复制到自己的命名空间中，从而实现跨命名空间的敏感信息读取。此漏洞属于访问控制缺陷，攻击者无需拥有集群管理员权限，仅需较低权限即可利用，且可利用网络远程触发（CVSS 向量中 AV:N）。CVSS 评分为 7.7（高危），影响机密性（C:H），但不影响完整性和可用性（I:N/A:N）。由于涉及 Kubernetes/OpenShift 环境中的 Secret 管理，可能导致凭据、令牌或其他机密数据泄露，进而可能被用于进一步横向移动或特权提升。目前该漏洞尚未被列入 KEV，也没有明确证据表明已在野外被利用，因此暂不确认其实际武器化程度。建议相关用户优先升级到已修复的版本，并在升级前严格限制 Channel 和 Subscription 资源的创建权限，同时监控日志中异常的 SecretRef 字段修改行为。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限命名空间管理员窃取其他命名空间的敏感 Secret，直接破坏多租户隔离，可能导致集群凭据和业务机密泄露，需尽快修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 信息泄露：攻击者可读取其他命名空间的 Secret 内容，造成敏感凭据、令牌等泄露；在 Kubernetes/OpenShift 多租户场景下风险显著，可能助长进一步攻击。

By exploiting this, an attacker can modify these Secrets in unauthorized areas. This could lead to unauthorized access to information or elevated privileges within the system.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-64927 是 multicloud-operators-channel 组件中的一个权限与机密信息管理漏洞。该组件用于多云环境下的渠道管理，涉及跨命名空间处理 Secrets 等敏感信息。漏洞的核心问题在于：具有特定低权限的用户能够利用组件在权限校验方面的缺失，越权修改其它命名空间中的 Secrets。虽然攻击前提是需要一定权限，但攻击面涉及网络（AV:N），且利用复杂度低，无需用户交互，影响范围可跨越安全边界（S:C），对机密性和完整性造成有限影响（C:L/I:L），可用性不受影响。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 6.4（中等），表明其风险中等但不容忽视。一旦被成功利用，攻击者可能篡改云环境中的敏感配置或凭据，进而获取未授权的访问，甚至提升自身权限，破坏多租户隔离。目前 NVD 仅提供元数据，未给出受影响产品和厂商信息，也未提供 EPSS 数据。已确认该漏洞尚未列入 KEV，且没有在野利用的明确标记。建议安全团队密切关注官方补丁或缓解措施公告，若相关组件已部署，应在评估影响后尽快更新或应用临时缓解措施，同时限制该组件的网络暴露范围，并采取最小权限原则，以降低潜在风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限用户跨命名空间篡改 Secrets，破坏多租户隔离，可能导致敏感信息泄露或权限提升，在云原生环境中影响广泛，需优先处置。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

btrfs: free mapping node on duplicate reloc root insert

__add_reloc_root() allocates a mapping_node before ...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

btrfs: free mapping node on duplicate reloc root insert

__add_reloc_root() allocates a mapping_node before inserting it into
rc->reloc_root_tree.  If rb_simple_insert() finds an existing entry, it
returns the existing rb_node and leaves the newly allocated node unlinked.

The error path then returns -EEXIST without freeing the new node.  Since
the node was never inserted into reloc_root_tree, the later cleanup in
put_reloc_control() cannot find it either.

Free the newly allocated node before returning -EEXIST.

The callers currently assert that -EEXIST should not happen, so this is a
defensive cleanup for an unexpected duplicate insert path.  If the path is
ever reached, the local allocation should still be released.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-68450 是 Linux 内核 btrfs 文件系统中的一个漏洞修复，涉及重复 reloc root 插入时的内存泄漏。在 btrfs 的 reloc 控制流程中，函数 __add_reloc_root() 负责将新的 reloc root 映射节点插入到 rc->reloc_root_tree 红黑树中。该函数首先分配一个 mapping_node 结构体，然后调用 rb_simple_insert() 尝试插入。如果树中已存在具有相同键的节点，rb_simple_insert() 会返回现有的 rb_node，而不会将新分配的节点链接到树中。然而，错误处理路径直接返回 -EEXIST，并未释放这个新分配的节点。由于该节点从未插入到 reloc_root_tree 中，后续在 put_reloc_control() 中进行的清理操作也无法找到并释放它，最终导致内存泄漏。修复措施是在返回 -EEXIST 之前显式释放这个新节点。当前调用者通常断言 -EEXIST 情况不应该发生，因此该修复属于防御性清理，用于处理意外出现的重复插入路径。如果该路径确实被触发，本地分配的内存应立即释放，以避免内核内存资源耗尽。该漏洞没有 CVSS 评分，也未列入 KEV，但作为安全加固措施，建议 Linux 用户更新至包含此补丁的内核版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该修复解决了 btrfs 在异常重复 reloc root 插入时的内存泄漏，虽为防御性清理，但可能导致内核内存泄漏和系统不稳定。及时更新内核可避免潜在风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 在罕见条件下，内核内存泄漏可能导致系统性能下降、资源耗尽，甚至崩溃。但该路径目前被认为不应该发生，实际风险较低。

The hand-rolled bit-scanning loop...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ata: sata_dwc_460ex: fix infinite loop in NCQ tag completion bit-scanning

The hand-rolled bit-scanning loop in the NCQ completion path has an
infinite loop bug.  When tag_mask has only high bits set (e.g.
0x80000000), the inner while loop left-shifts tag_mask until it
overflows to 0.  At that point !(0 & 1) is always true and 0 <<= 1
stays 0, causing an infinite loop in hardirq context with a spinlock
held.

Replace the open-coded bit-scanning with __ffs() which correctly
finds the least significant set bit and is bounded by the width of
the argument.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-68449 是 Linux 内核中的一个漏洞，具体位于 ata: sata_dwc_460ex 驱动中。该问题源于 NCQ（Native Command Queuing，原生命令队列）完成路径中的手工位扫描循环存在无限循环缺陷。当 tag_mask 仅包含高位（例如 0x80000000）时，内部 while 循环会将 tag_mask 左移直至溢出为 0。此时，条件 !(0 & 1) 始终为真，且 0 <<= 1 仍为 0，导致在持有自旋锁的硬中断上下文中陷入无限循环。这会造成系统挂起、死锁或拒绝服务。修复方式是用 __ffs() 替换开放编码的位扫描，__ffs() 能正确找到最低有效置位位，并且扫描次数受参数宽度限制，从而避免无限循环。该漏洞属于内核驱动层的本地错误，可能由特定硬件操作触发。当前无 CVSS 评分、无 EPSS 数据，也未被列入 KEV 或标记为在野利用。受影响产品未明确提供，但可推断为使用 sata_dwc_460ex 控制器的嵌入式或特定平台系统。建议及时更新 Linux 内核至修复版本，并限制相关设备或控制器的访问权限。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致内核在硬中断上下文死循环，造成系统崩溃或拒绝服务，且无需特殊权限即可触发。修复简单，但若未能及时更新，受影响设备稳定性将受严重影响。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可导致内核在硬中断上下文死循环，造成系统崩溃或拒绝服务，且无需特殊权限即可触发。修复简单，但若未能及时更新，受影响设备稳定性将受严重影响。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ovl: check access to copy_file_range source with src mounter creds

Commit 5dae222a5ff0c ("vfs: allow copy_f...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ovl: check access to copy_file_range source with src mounter creds

Commit 5dae222a5ff0c ("vfs: allow copy_file_range to copy across devices")
allowed filesystems that implement the copy_file_range() f_op to decide
if they want to access cross-sb copy from/to the same fs type.

The same commit added checks to verify same sb copy for filesystems that
implement ->copy_file_range() and do not support cross-sb copy at the
time, namely, to ceph, fuse and nfs.

The two remaining fs which implement ->copy_file_range(), cifs and
overlayfs started to support cross-sb copy from this time.

While overlayfs does support cross-sb copy when the two underlying files
are on the same base fs, the copy operation on the two real files from
two different overalyfs filesystems is performed with the mounter
creds of the destination overlayfs and the read permission access hook
for the source file was called with the wrong creds.

This could cause either deny of access to copy which would otherwise be
allowed (e.g. with splice) or allow read access to file which would
otherwise be denied.

Fix the latter case by explicitly verifying read access to source file
with the source overlayfs mounter creds.

The former case remains a quirk of cross-sb overlayfs copy, but
userspace could fall back to regular copy so no harm done.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-68448 是 Linux 内核中 overlayfs 文件系统的一个权限检查缺陷，与 copy_file_range() 系统调用的跨超级块复制机制相关。内核中用于跨设备复制的功能在 5dae222a5ff0c 提交中被引入，允许支持该操作的文件系统（如 cifs 和 overlayfs）处理跨挂载点复制。在 overlayfs 场景下，当数据从两个不同的 overlayfs 实例（底层文件位于同一或不同基础文件系统）复制时，内核错误地使用了目标 overlayfs 挂载者的凭证去检查源文件的读取权限，而正确的做法是使用源 overlayfs 自己的挂载凭证执行访问控制。这个逻辑错误带来了两个潜在后果：一是某些本应允许的读取复制操作会被错误拒绝（例如通过 splice 系统调用时），造成功能可用性问题；二是更严重的是，某些原本无权限访问的文件可能因为凭证错配而被成功读取，破坏了内核的权限隔离机制，形成本地信息泄露或越权读取。提交的修复方案是在复制操作中显式使用源 overlayfs 挂载者的凭据重新验证源文件的读取权限，以彻底关闭后一种错误授权路径。对于前一种拒绝问题，官方认为这是跨超级块 overlayfs 复制的一种固有行为怪癖，用户程序可自行回退到常规复制来规避，因此未做特殊处理。该漏洞影响启用 overlayfs 并依赖跨挂载复制功能的 Linux 系统，本地普通用户有可能利用其进行越权读取。鉴于没有 CVSS 评分且仅有元数据，严重程度初步评估为中等。目前暂无公开的在野利用情报，也未列入 KEV，但仍建议受影响的发行版及时更新内核补丁，并限制 overlayfs 的跨挂载操作以降低风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞源于 overlayfs 对 copy_file_range 源文件权限检查时使用了错误的挂载凭证，可能导致本地用户越权读取本无权限访问的文件，破坏内核权限隔离，存在信息泄露风险。鉴于 Linux 系统的广泛使用，应尽快修复。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/amdkfd: clamp v9 CRIU control stack checkpoint copy to BO size

CRIU checkpoint copies the MQD control s...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/amdkfd: clamp v9 CRIU control stack checkpoint copy to BO size

CRIU checkpoint copies the MQD control stack using cp_hqd_cntl_stack_size
from hardware without bounding it to the allocated BO region. If the HW
field is larger than the queue's control stack allocation, memcpy reads
past the BO into adjacent GTT memory and can leak kernel data to userspace.

Store the page-aligned control stack BO size in mqd_manager and clamp
checkpoint copies and reported checkpoint sizes to
min(cp_hqd_cntl_stack_size, mm->ctl_stack_size). Apply the same bound
for multi-XCC v9.4.3 checkpoint layout.

(cherry picked from commit 6c2abd0ec09e86c6323010673766f76050e28aa3)

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核的 drm/amdkfd 子系统中存在一个信息泄露漏洞。在 CRIU（Checkpoint/Restore In Userspace）检查点恢复流程中，复制 MQD（Memory Queue Descriptor）控制栈时，使用了来自硬件的 cp_hqd_cntl_stack_size 字段值，而没有将其限制在实际分配的 BO（Buffer Object）区域内。如果该硬件字段值大于队列控制栈的实际分配大小，memcpy 操作会越界读取相邻的 GTT（Graphics Translation Table）内存，导致内核数据泄露给用户空间。修复方法是：在 mqd_manager 中存储按页对齐的控制栈 BO 大小，并将检查点复制操作以及上报的检查点大小限制为 min(cp_hqd_cntl_stack_size, mm->ctl_stack_size)。同时，对多 XCC 架构的 v9.4.3 检查点布局也应用了相同的边界限制。此漏洞影响使用 amdkfd 驱动的系统，尤其是在启用 CRIU 功能的场景下。攻击者可能通过精心构造的检查点操作触发越界读取，从而获取敏感的内核内存信息。该漏洞已通过提交 6c2abd0ec09e86c6323010673766f76050e28aa3 的代码修复。建议相关用户尽快应用补丁，以消除风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致内核堆内存越界读取，将敏感内核数据泄露给用户态进程，破坏系统机密性。由于涉及 amdkfd 图形驱动，影响使用相关 GPU 的 Linux 系统，建议优先修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可造成内核数据泄露，可能暴露进程内存、文件缓存等敏感内容，为后续攻击提供铺垫。目前无证据表明已被在野利用。

items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Open5GS up to 2.7.1. This issue affects the function pcrf_rx_aar_cb of the file src/pcrf/pcrf-rx-path.c of the component Diameter Rx Handler. The manipulation of the argument num_of_media_component/num_of_sub leads to buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 2.7.2 is capable of addressing this issue. The identifier of the patch is 87b4e4535c77ded627cdb6f4e4e2e3ea761f40b7. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Open5GS 2.7.1及之前版本存在缓冲区溢出漏洞（CVE-2024-14044）。漏洞位于PCRF组件的Diameter Rx处理器中，具体涉及pcrf_rx_aar_cb函数（src/pcrf/pcrf-rx-path.c）。攻击者通过操纵参数num_of_media_component/num_of_sub，可触发缓冲区溢出，且攻击可通过网络远程发起，无需物理访问。根据描述，利用代码已公开，可能被实际使用。升级到2.7.2版本可解决该问题，官方补丁标识为87b4e4535c77ded627cdb6f4e4e2e3ea761f40b7。CVSS评分为6.3（中危），攻击复杂度低，需要低权限，对机密性、完整性、可用性均有影响。当前该漏洞未列入CISA KEV目录，也未被明确标注为在野利用，但鉴于利用代码公开，实际风险较高。建议受影响用户尽快升级，并评估Diameter Rx接口的网络暴露情况，限制访问来源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Open5GS是5G核心网开源实现的关键组件。该漏洞位于PCRF Rx Diameter处理器，可被远程触发缓冲区溢出，可能导致服务崩溃或未授权操作，且利用代码已公开，需尽快修复。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/vmwgfx: Validate vmw_surface_metadata::array_size

This field comes from userspace and should be validated against specific
limits depending on which Shader Model (SM) is available.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于Linux内核的DRM子系统中的VMware显卡驱动(vmwgfx)内。具体地，函数在处理用户提交的表面创建请求时，未正确验证`vmw_surface_metadata::array_size`字段。该字段来自用户空间，描述表面在纹理数组中的层数。由于缺乏与当前可用Shader Model (SM)版本对应的硬性限制比较，恶意用户空间程序可通过`drm_ioctl`调用传递过大的array_size。这可能导致内核在后续的内存分配或计算偏移时发生整数溢出或越界访问，进而引发内存损坏、信息泄漏或系统崩溃。在虚拟机环境（如VMware Workstation/Fusion/ESXi）中，该驱动被大量使用，漏洞可能被guest用户用于攻击宿主或获取更高权限。官方补丁已提交，核心是针对不同SM版本定义合理阈值并验证输入。建议立即更新内核并重新编译/部署，同时限制对DRM设备节点（/dev/dri/card*）的访问权限。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞为VMware图形驱动中的输入验证缺失，在虚拟化场景中易被本地利用，可能导致提权或系统崩溃，应优先修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可构造恶意array_size触发越界操作，造成内存损坏、敏感信息暴露和DoS；在虚拟机中可能影响宿主安全。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞为VMware图形驱动中的输入验证缺失，在虚拟化场景中易被本地利用，可能导致提权或系统崩溃，应优先修复。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/vc4: Prevent shader BO mappings from becoming writable

vc4_gem_object_mmap() rejects a writable mapping...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/vc4: Prevent shader BO mappings from becoming writable

vc4_gem_object_mmap() rejects a writable mapping of a validated shader
BO, but leaves VM_MAYWRITE set.  Userspace can map the BO read-only and
then turn it writable with mprotect().

Validated shader BOs must stay read-only: the validator checks the
instructions once and the GPU trusts them afterwards.  A writable
mapping lets userspace rewrite the code after validation, bypassing the
validator.

Clear VM_MAYWRITE on the read-only path so the mapping cannot be
upgraded, as i915 already does for its read-only objects.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本CVE涉及Linux内核drm/vc4驱动中的一个安全漏洞。在vc4_gem_object_mmap()函数中，当用户请求对已验证的shader BO进行只读映射时，该函数正确地拒绝了可写映射，但没有清除VMA的VM_MAYWRITE标志。这导致用户空间可以先以只读方式映射该对象，然后通过mprotect()系统调用将映射升级为可写。经过验证的shader BO本应只能保持只读，因为验证器仅对指令执行一次检查，之后GPU会信任这些指令。如果允许映射变为可写，用户空间可以在验证之后修改着色器代码，从而绕过验证器的安全检查，可能导致GPU执行被篡改的代码，进而造成权限提升或其他安全影响。修复方案是，在只读路径上清除VM_MAYWRITE标志，使映射无法被升级为可写。该修复方式与i915驱动对只读对象的处理方式一致。此漏洞影响Linux内核的drm/vc4子系统，主要涉及使用该驱动的设备（如树莓派系列）。由于没有提供CVSS评分和利用情况，严重性尚未正式评估，但从漏洞性质看，本地用户可能利用它绕过安全机制，建议受影响的系统及时更新内核补丁。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许本地用户将已验证的着色器内存映射升级为可写，绕过GPU验证器，可能篡改GPU代码，导致权限提升或不受信任代码执行。虽然未确认在野利用，但影响内核安全边界，需及时修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用该漏洞的攻击者可能修改经过验证的着色器指令，使GPU执行任意代码，从而可能提升权限或破坏系统完整性。由于是本地漏洞，需要本地访问权限。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许本地用户将已验证的着色器内存映射升级为可写，绕过GPU验证器，可能篡改GPU代码，导致权限提升或不受信任代码执行。虽然未确认在野利用，但影响内核安全边界，需及时修复。

ffa_partition_info_get() passes uuid_st...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

firmware: arm_ffa: Fix NULL dereference in ffa_partition_info_get()

ffa_partition_info_get() passes uuid_str directly to uuid_parse()
without a NULL check. When a caller passes NULL, uuid_parse() ->
__uuid_parse() -> uuid_is_valid() dereferences the pointer, causing
a kernel panic:

  |  Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at virtual address
  |  0000000000000040
  |  pc : uuid_parse+0x40/0xac
  |  lr : ffa_partition_info_get+0x1c/0x94 [arm_ffa]

Add a NULL guard before uuid_parse() so a NULL argument returns
-ENODEV instead of crashing. Callers are expected to always supply
a valid partition UUID, so NULL is not a supported input.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-68444 是 Linux 内核中 ARM 固件框架（arm_ffa）模块的一个空指针解引用漏洞。具体问题出现在 ffa_partition_info_get() 函数中，该函数将传入的 uuid_str 参数直接传递给 uuid_parse()，而没有先检查该参数是否为 NULL。当调用方传入 NULL 时，uuid_parse() 内部的 __uuid_parse() 和 uuid_is_valid() 会对空指针进行解引用，导致内核崩溃（Kernel Panic）。漏洞利用导致内核无法处理空指针，在 arm64 系统上可能触发内核 oops，造成系统拒绝服务。修复方式是在调用 uuid_parse() 之前增加空指针守卫，若参数为 NULL 则直接返回 -ENODEV，避免崩溃。该漏洞属于驱动程序内部函数，调用方预期总是提供有效的分区 UUID，NULL 并非受支持的输入，因此实际触发条件可能较难满足，但当系统启用 ARM FF-A 接口且某个调用者错误地传递 NULL 时，就会引发可靠性问题。由于该漏洞位于内核固件子系统，影响范围与内核版本和 ARM 平台配置相关，通常需要管理员权限才能调用相关接口，但一旦触发便可能导致系统崩溃。建议相关厂商和用户尽快跟踪 Linux 内核上游修复补丁，并在稳定分支中进行相应更新。由于官方暂未给出 CVSS 评分和 EPSS 数据，也未列入 KEV 或标记存在在野利用，处置优先级中等，但仍是值得关注的可用性缺陷。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致 Linux 内核空指针解引用并崩溃，影响 ARM FF-A 机制的系统可用性。修复方式简单，但未打补丁的版本存在本地拒绝服务风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者或错误调用者可通过传入 NULL 触发内核 panic，导致系统崩溃、可用性受损。若相关接口在可信边界外可用，可能被用于本地拒绝服务攻击。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可导致 Linux 内核空指针解引用并崩溃，影响 ARM FF-A 机制的系统可用性。修复方式简单，但未打补丁的版本存在本地拒绝服务风险。

Calling hid_hw_stop() does not stop ...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

hwmon: (gigabyte_waterforce) Stop device IO before calling hid_hw_stop

Calling hid_hw_stop() does not stop the device IO.
This results in a race condition between hid_input_report() and the point
immediately following the execution of hid_device_io_start() within
the driver probe function. If the probe operation fails after "io start"
has been initiated, this race condition will result in a UAF vulnerability.

Fix the problem by calling hid_device_io_stop() before calling
hid_hw_stop().

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-68443 是 Linux 内核 hwmon 子系统中的 gigabyte_waterforce 驱动程序存在的一个释放后使用（UAF）漏洞。根据 NVD 提供的描述，该漏洞源于驱动在调用 hid_hw_stop() 之前未正确停止设备的 I/O 操作。具体来说，hid_hw_stop() 本身并不会停止设备 I/O，这导致了在驱动探测（probe）函数内部，hid_input_report() 与紧随 hid_device_io_start() 执行之后的代码之间存在竞态条件。如果探测操作在“io start”已经发起之后失败，则该竞态条件可能触发 UAF 漏洞，造成内核内存被错误访问，进而可能导致系统崩溃、权限提升或其他未定义行为。修复措施是在调用 hid_hw_stop() 之前先调用 hid_device_io_stop() 来停止设备 I/O，从而消除竞态条件。目前此漏洞尚未被列入已知被利用漏洞（KEV）目录，也没有在野利用的明确标记。受影响的精确产品版本和厂商信息尚未提供，但该漏洞影响使用 gigabyte_waterforce 驱动的 Linux 内核系统。建议相关用户关注内核官方补丁更新，及时将内核升级到修复版本，同时如果系统暴露于不可信环境，应限制相关硬件设备的访问权限和网络暴露面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞是 Linux 内核驱动中的 UAF，可能被本地攻击者利用导致内核崩溃或权限提升。修复方式简单，但影响所有使用 gigabyte_waterforce 驱动的内核系统，需及时更新内核以消除风险。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞是 Linux 内核驱动中的 UAF，可能被本地攻击者利用导致内核崩溃或权限提升。修复方式简单，但影响所有使用 gigabyte_waterforce 驱动的内核系统，需及时更新内核以消除风险。

When a TC filter attached to a qdisc filter chai...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net/sched: Handle TC_ACT_REDIRECT from qdisc filter chains

When a TC filter attached to a qdisc filter chain returns
TC_ACT_REDIRECT (ex: via an eBPF program calling bpf_redirect() or an
act_bpf action), the redirect was silently lost i.e no qdisc classify
function handled TC_ACT_REDIRECT, so the packet fell through the
switch and was enqueued normally instead of being redirected.

This has been broken since bpf_redirect() was introduced for TC in
commit 27b29f63058d ("bpf: add bpf_redirect() helper"). We got lucky
for a long time because bpf_net_context was a per-CPU variable that
was always available.

commit 401cb7dae813 ("net: Reference bpf_redirect_info via task_struct
on PREEMPT_RT.") turned bpf_net_context into a task_struct member that
is only set up by explicit callers. Without a caller setting it up,
bpf_redirect() itself crashes with a NULL pointer dereference in
bpf_net_ctx_get_ri(). However, even with bpf_net_context available,
TC_ACT_REDIRECT from qdisc filter chains cannot be honored without
adding skb_do_redirect() calls to every qdisc classify function, which
would require changes across net/sched/. Isolate it to ebpf core where
it belongs.

Instead, add a tcf_classify_qdisc() inline helper in pkt_cls.h, as a
wrapper around tcf_classify() for use by qdisc classify functions and
tcf_qevent_handle(). When the classify verdict is TC_ACT_REDIRECT,
the wrapper converts it to TC_ACT_SHOT, dropping the packet rather
than letting it continue silently. Dropping is preferred over
letting the packet through because the user immediately sees packet
loss. Silently passing the packet through would hide the problem and
leave the user wondering why their redirect is not working.

The clsact fast path, tc_run() continues to call tcf_classify() directly
and is unaffected: TC_ACT_REDIRECT is returned as-is and handled by
sch_handle_egress/ingress() calling skb_do_redirect() as before.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于 Linux 内核的 net/sched 子系统。当 TC 过滤器（例如通过 eBPF 程序调用 bpf_redirect() 或使用 act_bpf 动作）返回 TC_ACT_REDIRECT 时，qdisc 的 classify 函数未能处理该动作，导致重定向被静默忽略，数据包按普通路径入队，而不是被重定向到指定接口。这个问题自 bpf_redirect() 辅助函数引入 TC 起就存在。由于 bpf_net_context 原先为 per-CPU 变量，行为正常；但 commit 401cb7dae813（将 bpf_net_context 改为 task_struct 成员，仅由显式调用者设置）之后，未设置该上下文时，bpf_redirect() 本身会因空指针解引用而崩溃（bpf_net_ctx_get_ri() 访问空指针）。即使 bpf_net_context 可用，要正确处理 TC_ACT_REDIRECT 也需要在每个 qdisc classify 函数中添加 skb_do_redirect() 调用，这会涉及大量 net/sched 改动。因此，补丁方案是在 pkt_cls.h 中添加 tcf_classify_qdisc() 内联包装函数，供 qdisc classify 函数和 tcf_qevent_handle() 使用；当分类结果等于 TC_ACT_REDIRECT 时，将其转换为 TC_ACT_SHOT，即直接丢弃数据包。这样做的原因是丢弃行为会立即导致用户观察到丢包，从而提示配置存在问题；而静默放行会让用户困惑于重定向为何不生效。值得注意的是，clsact 快速路径（tc_run()）不受影响，它仍然直接调用 tcf_classify()，TC_ACT_REDIRECT 会原样返回并由 sch_handle_egress/ingress() 调用 skb_do_redirect() 完成重定向。该补丁属于修复性改动，未改变快速路径的行为。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞影响 Linux 内核中 TC/qdisc 与 eBPF 重定向配合的场景，可能导致重定向失效或内核崩溃（空指针解引用），影响网络数据转发功能的正确性与稳定性。建议及时更新内核以包含此修复，并避免在内核未打补丁时使用相关 eBPF 重定向功能。

txgbe_read_eeprom_hostif() always copies round_up(...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: txgbe: fix heap overflow when reading module EEPROM

txgbe_read_eeprom_hostif() always copies round_up(length, 4) bytes
into the caller buffer, which ethtool allocates with exactly 'length'
bytes. A non-4-aligned length therefore causes an out-of-bounds write.
Copy only the remaining bytes on the final dword instead.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-68440 是 Linux 内核 txgbe 网络驱动中的一个堆溢出漏洞。漏洞位于 txgbe_read_eeprom_hostif() 函数，该函数在读取模块 EEPROM 数据时，始终复制 round_up(length, 4) 字节到调用者提供的缓冲区，而 ethtool 分配缓冲区时使用的是原始 length 字节。当 length 不是 4 的倍数时，复制操作会超出缓冲区边界，造成堆越界写入。该问题由非对齐的长度触发，可能导致内核堆内存破坏、系统崩溃，甚至被本地攻击者利用来提升权限。修复方式是在最后一个双字（dword）只复制剩余的字节，而不是强制对齐到 4 字节。目前该漏洞没有 CVSS 评分，也未列入 KEV 或在野利用记录。受影响的产品范围未明确提供，但凡是使用受影响 txgbe 驱动的 Linux 内核版本均可能受此漏洞影响。建议用户尽快更新到包含修复补丁的内核版本，并限制对网络设备的物理或管理访问，以降低风险。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: mt76: mt7925: fix possible NULL-pointer deref in mt7925_mcu_bss_he_tlv()

mt76_connac_get_he_phy_cap r...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: mt76: mt7925: fix possible NULL-pointer deref in mt7925_mcu_bss_he_tlv()

mt76_connac_get_he_phy_cap routine can theoretically return NULL so
check cap pointer before dereferencing it.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-68439 是 Linux 内核无线子系统 mt76 驱动中 mt7925 芯片组相关的一个缺陷修复。具体而言，在 mt7925_mcu_bss_he_tlv() 函数中，函数 mt76_connac_get_he_phy_cap 理论上可能返回 NULL 指针，而原代码在返回后未进行检查便直接解引用该指针，从而可能导致空指针解引用，引发内核崩溃或拒绝服务。本次修复在解引用前增加了对 cap 指针的检查，确保安全性。该漏洞影响使用 mt7925 无线网卡的 Linux 系统，常见于笔记本、嵌入式设备等。由于该问题属于内核驱动代码缺陷，触发条件可能与特定无线网络环境或配置相关，本地攻击者或恶意无线设备有可能通过构造特定帧来触发。但根据现有元数据，尚无 CVSS 评分、EPSS 数据，也未标记为已知被利用或已纳入 KEV。因此，该漏洞的真实严重性尚未公开量化评估，但属于需要关注的内核稳定性问题。建议用户关注发行版内核更新，及时应用补丁以修复该空指针解引用问题。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能导致内核空指针解引用而崩溃，影响系统稳定性。虽未在野利用证据，但无线驱动常暴露于不可信环境，应尽快修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 在特定场景下（如处理特定 HE 能力的 BSS 信息）可触发空指针解引用，造成内核 oops 或系统崩溃，影响可用性。

items.title: What Keeps Agent Skills from Being Reusable? Evidence from 138K SKILL.md Files
items.summary: Under the current standard, Agent Skills are SKILL.md files that combine instructions with supporting resources, enabling Large Language Model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures beyond a single conversation. Yet many public skills appear to originate from a single task, repository, or conversation, even when they are shared as reusable components. We analyze this gap across 138,133 public SKILL.md files from 20,556 repositories using a two-tier defect taxonomy grounded in the official specification and best-practice guidance. We find that 91.8% of skills contain at least one detected defect, with stable estimates across lenient and strict thresholds (88.8-94.6%). The dominant failures are ordinary packaging problems rather than exotic attacks: weak routing metadata, bloated or non-actionable bodies, and poor resource organization. A deterministic routing stress test over 20,000 skills shows the functional impact: skills with valid routing metadata are retrieved more reliably from startup descriptions than skills with routing defects. Defect rates vary by platform and provenance: specification-aware skills contain fewer defects, while AI-marked skills show more safety and portability problems. Lightweight enforcement and repair experiments support a quality-assured generation workflow combining spec-aware prompting, lightweight linting, automated repair, and safety gating.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对当前 Agent Skills（智能体技能）标准下技能可复用性不足的问题展开了大规模实证研究。Agent Skills 通常以 SKILL.md 文件形式存在，将指令与辅助资源结合，使大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够在多次对话之外复用特定流程。然而，许多公开分享的技能往往源自单一任务、仓库或对话，即使它们被标榜为可复用组件。作者基于官方规范与最佳实践指南，提出了一种双层缺陷分类法，并对来自 20,556 个代码仓库的 138,133 个公开 SKILL.md 文件进行了系统分析。研究结果显示，91.8% 的技能至少存在一个检测到的缺陷，且在宽松与严格阈值下估计值保持稳定（88.8%–94.6%）。主要失败类型并非恶意攻击，而是普通的打包问题：路由元数据薄弱、正文臃肿或不可操作、资源组织混乱。通过对 20,000 个技能进行确定性路由压力测试，发现具有有效路由元数据的技能在启动描述中的检索可靠性显著优于存在路由缺陷的技能。进一步分析显示，缺陷率因平台和来源而异：符合规范的技能缺陷较少，而带有 AI 标记的技能在安全性和可移植性方面问题更多。最后，作者通过轻量级强制和修复实验，验证了一种结合规范感知提示、轻量级 lint、自动修复和安全门控的质量保证生成流程的有效性。该研究为 Agent Skills 的生态质量提供了首个大规模量化证据，并为技能开发工具与平台治理提出了可落地的改进方向。适合智能体平台开发者、LLM 应用工程师以及关注 AI 供应链安全的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Agent Skills 正成为 LLM 智能体复用的关键载体，但绝大多数公开技能存在包装缺陷，直接影响智能体任务执行的可靠性与安全性。该研究揭示了规范缺失导致的系统性质量问题，为蓝队评估智能体供应链风险提供了实证基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖公开 Agent Skills 的 LLM 智能体生态系统，包括技能市场、企业内部分享及自动化工作流。缺陷技能可能导致路由失败、资源错用或安全门控缺失，进而引发误操作或数据泄露。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: ActBench: Self-Evolving Benchmark of Behavioral Safety in Cowork Agents
items.summary: Cowork agents may complete benign tasks while disclosing protected data, manipulating unauthorized state, invocate unauthorized API. We define behavioral safety and introduce ActBench, a self-evolving benchmark that evaluates such behavior risk from execution trajectories rather than final responses. Each case pairs a benign task with an adversarial variant that preserves its instruction, configuration, initial state, rating model, and trusted records while injecting a task-reachable payload. ActBench contains 600 cases from 213 scenarios, spanning 15 risk behaviors, six execution spaces, and 48 web-service APIs.To move beyond static payloads, we propose a reward-guided beam search method that jointly optimizes attack effectiveness and task utility, while reflection diagnoses failed execution checkpoint and guides payload revision. Besides, we propose a dual evidence verification mechanism that verifies agent execution safety and utility through log evidence and LLM-based trajectory evidence.We evaluate 15 LLMs and 6 open-source cowork agents over 24,000 trajectories. Under a fixed harness, attack success rates ranges from 10.1% to 94.4% across models, while under a fixed base model, they range from 73.7% to 94.4% across agents.These results show greater variation across models than agent harness, while attacks remain highly successful across all tested harnesses.Our benchmark is released at: https://github.com/zjuicsr/ActBench.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 协作智能体（cowork agents）在执行看似良性的任务时，可能同时发生受保护数据泄露、未授权状态篡改或未授权API调用等行为风险。现有安全评测大多基于最终响应判断，难以捕捉执行过程中的违规行为。为此，本文定义了“行为安全”（behavioral safety）概念，并引入 ActBench——一个自进化的行为安全基准，专注于从执行轨迹而非最终回复来评估风险。ActBench 的每个用例都由一个良性任务和一个对抗变体配对而成，对抗变体保留原始任务的指令、配置、初始状态、评分模型和可信记录，同时注入任务可达的恶意载荷。基准共包含来自 213 个场景的 600 个用例，覆盖 15 种风险行为、6 类执行空间以及 48 个 Web 服务 API。为了突破静态载荷的局限，论文提出了一种奖励引导的束搜索方法，该方法联合优化攻击有效性和任务可用性，并通过反思机制诊断失败的执行检查点来指导载荷修订。同时，作者设计了双证据验证机制，结合日志证据和基于大语言模型的轨迹证据，全面验证智能体的执行安全性和任务效用。实验部分，作者在 24,000 条轨迹上评估了 15 个 LLM 和 6 个开源协作智能体。结果显示，在固定 harness 下，不同模型的攻击成功率介于 10.1% 至 94.4% 之间；在固定基座模型下，不同智能体框架的攻击成功率介于 73.7% 至 94.4% 之间。这表明攻击成功率在不同模型之间的差异远大于不同 harness 之间的差异，且现有所有测试 harness 都高度易受攻击。ActBench 已开源（https://github.com/zjuicsr/ActBench），为智能体行为安全提供了系统性评测工具，对 LLM 安全对齐、智能体权限控制以及安全审计具有重要意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准首次从执行轨迹层面系统评估协作智能体的行为安全，揭示模型间显著差异，为智能体应用的安全测试与加固提供可复用的基准和方法。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于LLM的智能体应用的安全性评测，可迁移至智能体风险评估、权限控制策略设计、安全测试自动化等场景。
defense_advice_zh: 在智能体执行过程中启用详细日志审计，记录所有API调用和状态变更。
采用双证据验证机制，结合日志和LLM轨迹证据进行实时安全校验。
对智能体实施最小权限原则，限制其访问敏感数据和关键API。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting for Black-Box LLM Ownership Verification
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are high-value assets that can be derived through redeployment, fine-tuning, quantization, or further alignment. Because deployed LLMs are commonly exposed only through query APIs, ownership verification must often rely on black-box text responses. This setting is difficult: generations are open-ended and can vary across repeated queries, while existing black-box fingerprints rely on signals that are fragile under a final-response interface, including full-text matching, soft behavioral features, or model-specific prompts designed not to transfer. We propose TCF (Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting), a black-box LLM fingerprinting framework that converts open-ended generation comparison into constrained-answer targeted counterfactual transfer. TCF restricts each verification query to a finite answer space, reducing the surface-form ambiguity that enters the verification score, and optimizes a prompt perturbation toward a counterfactual target different from the protected model's clean answer on the original prompt. Verification reduces to checking whether the suspect model's parsed final answer matches the recorded target. We introduce the source-model counterfactual margin (SCM), a protected-model-only quantity that certifies the target is unlikely before the perturbation and likely after it; SCM controls target selection, perturbation stopping, and fingerprint filtering. Under explicit derived-preservation and independent-transfer budgets motivated by local behavioral closeness, we derive a target-accuracy gap between derived and independent models. Across four LLM families, TCF achieves an average AUC of 0.9861, improving over TRAP, ProFLingo, and ZeroPrint by 0.07 to 0.19.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）作为高价值资产，常面临通过重新部署、微调、量化或进一步对齐而衍生的窃取风险。由于部署后的LLM通常仅通过黑盒查询API对外暴露，所有权验证往往依赖于文本响应的比对。然而，黑盒环境下的开放式生成具有高度的表面形式可变性，重复查询结果可能不同，而现有指纹方法（如全文本匹配、软行为特征或依赖模型特定提示）在最终响应接口下较为脆弱，难以有效完成所有权验证。针对这一难题，本文提出目标反事实指纹识别（TCF）框架，将开放式生成比较转化为受限答案下的目标反事实迁移问题。具体而言，TCF将每个验证查询限制为有限的候选答案集合，从而降低表面形式差异对验证分数的干扰；同时，通过优化提示扰动，使受保护模型在扰动后的答案从原始干净答案迁移到一个预设的目标答案。验证过程只需检查嫌疑模型解析后的最终答案是否与记录的目标一致。文章进一步引入源模型反事实边际（SCM），利用仅基于受保护模型的计算度量，确保目标在扰动前出现的概率极低，而在扰动后高度可能出现，并以此控制目标选择、扰动停止及指纹筛选过程。基于局部行为接近性，作者还从理论上推导了派生模型与独立模型之间的目标准确率差距，为方法提供了可解释的保障。在四个LLM家族上的实验表明，TCF的平均AUC达到0.9861，相比TRAP、ProFLingo和ZeroPrint等方法提升0.07至0.19，验证了其较高的鲁棒性和有效性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文为LLM模型所有权验证提供了新的黑盒指纹方法，面对模型派生、微调等场景更稳健，有助于防御模型窃取争议，适合模型提供商和安全研究团队关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于LLM知识产权保护、模型溯源、以及检测未授权派生模型；也可扩展到其他序列生成模型的指纹验证。
defense_advice_zh: 对于LLM服务商，建议在模型生命周期中登记原始指纹；若怀疑存在盗用，可采用TCF方法进行黑盒验证，并结合服务日志进行追溯。

items.title: BASIS: Breach-Aware Selective Prompt Injection Shielding with Prefill Attention Probes
items.summary: Prompt injection is a critical security threat in large language model (LLM) applications, where attackers hijack model behavior by embedding malicious instructions in user or external data. Existing detection methods only detect the presence of injection and refuse to respond upon detection, overlooking the fact that for many modern aligned models, well-crafted instructions can resist most injection attacks. This means that the injection robustness varies significantly across instructions and models. This leads to widespread unnecessary over-refusal: inputs containing injections that the model could have handled correctly are rejected incorrectly. To deal with this over-refusal issue, we propose BASIS (Robustness-Aware Prompt Injection Defense). This defense method uses the Attention Competition Ratio ($ρ$) as features to train two sparse linear probes: an existence probe and a breach probe. Both probes make defense decisions through cascaded gating, which does not require additional LLM inference. BASIS comprises three stages: injection existence detection, per-sample breach prediction, and instruction robustness assessment; the online cascade refuses only when the model would actually be compromised and thus avoids over-refusal on robust instructions. Experiments across four tasks and six open-source LLMs show that BASIS maintains near-perfect injection detection while substantially reducing over-refusal on safe attack samples, especially under robust instruction templates.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）应用面临提示注入这一严重安全威胁，攻击者通过将恶意指令嵌入用户输入或外部数据来劫持模型行为。现有检测方法仅判断注入是否存在，并在检测到时一律拒绝响应，却忽略了关键事实：对于许多现代对齐模型而言，精心构造的指令可以抵抗大多数注入攻击，这意味着不同指令和模型的注入鲁棒性存在显著差异。这种一刀切的做法导致大量不必要的过度拒绝——本可安全处理的包含注入的输入被错误拒绝，严重损害了用户体验和应用可用性。为解决这一问题，本文提出 BASIS（鲁棒性感知的提示注入防御）。该方法利用注意力竞争比（Attention Competition Ratio, ρ）作为特征，训练两个稀疏线性探针：存在探针（existence probe）和漏洞探针（breach probe）。这两个探针通过级联门控进行决策，无需额外的 LLM 推理开销。BASIS 包含三个阶段：注入存在检测、逐样本漏洞预测和指令鲁棒性评估；在线级联仅在模型真正可能被攻破时才拒绝请求，从而避免对鲁棒指令的过度拒绝。实验在四个任务和六个开源 LLM 上进行，结果显示 BASIS 在维持接近完美的注入检测性能的同时，显著减少了对安全攻击样本的过度拒绝，尤其在鲁棒指令模板下表现突出。本研究为 LLM 应用提供了一种更精细、更智能的提示注入防御新思路，在安全性和可用性之间取得了更好的平衡。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究指出了现有提示注入防御的过度拒绝问题，并提出一种无需额外推理、可感知指令鲁棒性的轻量级防御方案。对于部署 LLM 应用的安全团队，既能保持高检测率，又能避免误杀安全输入，提升服务可用性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于基于 LLM 的客服、内容生成、代理系统等场景，特别是需要平衡安全与用户体验的在线服务。该防御思路可迁移到其他依赖模板指令的 LLM 应用，并为后续更智能的注入防护研究提供新方向。
defense_advice_zh: 采用鲁棒性感知的防御策略，避免对含注入的输入一律拒绝，而是评估当前指令和模型的真实脆弱性后再决策。
可使用注意力竞争比等特征构建轻量级探针，在不增加 LLM 推理开销的前提下实现细粒度注入防护。
对于鲁棒指令模板，应保留正常响应，仅在模型确会被攻破时进行阻断，以降低过度拒绝率。

items.title: On Understanding, Identifying, and Mitigating Vulnerabilities in Agentic Large Language Models
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have undergone a shift from stateless conversational interfaces to autonomous agents capable of multi-step planning, tool invocation, code execution, and maintaining persistent memory. When these agents operate with real-world privileges---calling APIs, modifying files, and querying databases---a compromised reasoning step can trigger unauthorized data access, irreversible state changes, or cascading failures, yet the security research community has not kept pace. To quantify the state of the field, we conducted a systematic literature review under PRISMA 2020 guidelines across six databases, screening 743 records and retaining 85 papers (2023--2025) on agentic LLM security. Attack research outpaces defense work by 3.9:1. Perception-layer vulnerabilities (prompt injection, jailbreaking, adversarial perturbations) dominate, accounting for 66\% of papers, while action-layer vulnerabilities (tool misuse, code injection, sandbox escape) appear in only 4.7\%, misaligned with real-world risk. Code execution security accounts for 3.5\%, and tool-augmented agents 12\%. We contribute a four-layer taxonomy mapping 13 vulnerability types across perception, brain, action, and interaction layers, and identify seven open problems centered on containment. Agentic LLM insecurity stems from architectural coupling, where weak isolation allows vulnerabilities to propagate across layers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文针对自主型大语言模型（Agentic LLM）的安全脆弱性进行了系统性研究。研究背景是：大语言模型已从无状态对话接口演进为具备多步规划、工具调用、代码执行和持久记忆的自主智能体；当这些智能体被授予真实权限（如调用 API、修改文件、查询数据库）时，一次受干扰的推理步骤就可能引发未授权数据访问、不可逆状态变更或级联故障。然而，安全研究社区的关注度明显不足。为量化该领域研究现状，作者遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南，对六个数据库进行系统性文献综述，筛选了 743 条记录，最终保留 2023 至 2025 年间的 85 篇关于智能体 LLM 安全的论文。研究发现：攻击类研究是防御类研究的 3.9 倍；感知层脆弱性（提示注入、越狱、对抗扰动）占据主导，出现在 66% 的论文中；而动作层脆弱性（工具滥用、代码注入、沙箱逃逸）仅占 4.7%，与现实风险严重不匹配；代码执行安全占 3.5%，工具增强型智能体占 12%。作者贡献了一个四层分类体系，将 13 种脆弱性类型映射到感知（perception）、大脑（brain）、动作（action）和交互（interaction）四个层面，并识别出以遏制（containment）为核心的七个开放问题。论文核心结论是：智能体 LLM 的不安全根源于架构耦合——由于隔离薄弱，脆弱性能够在不同层之间传播。该研究为安全社区提供了系统化的脆弱性地图，有助于后续研究者厘清重点攻击面与防御空白。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为智能体安全提供首个系统性证据：攻击研究远超防御，且感知层被过度关注，动作层高风险却研究不足，帮助蓝队调整防御重心。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面包括所有基于 LLM 的自主智能体系统，尤其是具备 API 调用、代码执行和文件修改能力的生产系统；其分类法和开放问题可直接用于指导威胁建模与安全评估。

items.title: From Prompt Injection to Web Exploitation: Revisiting Classic Vulnerabilities in LLM-Integrated Applications
items.summary: Large Language Models are increasingly integrated into web applications through chatbots, tool-calling pipelines, and agentic workflows. In these systems, user input may influence not only generated text, but also backend actions such as database queries, HTTP requests, file operations, template rendering, or API calls. This paper introduces LLM-mediated web attacks, a class of attacks in which attacker-controlled input is transformed by an LLM-integrated application and then reaches traditional web-application sinks. We systematize this attack surface through representative LLM2X variants, including LLM2SQLi, LLM2XSS, LLM2SSTI, LLM2CommandInjection, LLM2IDOR, LLM2CSRF, LLM2XXE, and LLM2SSRF. Our analysis shows that the LLM usually does not create the underlying vulnerability itself; rather, it acts as a mediation layer, and in some tool-enabled settings as a confused deputy, carrying attacker influence into components that trust model-generated or model-influenced content. As an experimental case study, we implement TicketOracle, a Flask-based LLM-integrated web application for evaluating LLM2SSRF across five attack scenarios and seven LLMs. Our results show substantial variation in susceptibility across models, suggesting that exploitation depends both on insecure application architecture and model-specific behavior. We conclude with mitigation strategies across the prompt, model, application, and network layers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了在将大语言模型集成到Web应用（如聊天机器人、工具调用流水线和智能体工作流）时产生的一类新型攻击面——LLM中介的Web攻击（LLM-mediated web attacks）。在这种架构下，用户输入不仅影响生成文本，还可能通过模型间接触发后端动作，如数据库查询、HTTP请求、文件操作、模板渲染或API调用。作者系统化了这一攻击面，提出LLM2X系列变体，包括LLM2SQLi（SQL注入）、LLM2XSS（跨站脚本）、LLM2SSTI（服务端模板注入）、LLM2CommandInjection（命令注入）、LLM2IDOR（不安全的直接对象引用）、LLM2CSRF（跨站请求伪造）、LLM2XXE（XML外部实体）和LLM2SSRF（服务端请求伪造）。核心发现是LLM通常并不创造底层漏洞，而是作为中介层，在某些工具启用场景下扮演混乱代理（confused deputy），将攻击者的影响力传递到信任模型生成内容的组件。作为实验案例，作者实现了TicketOracle——一个基于Flask的LLM集成Web应用，用于在5种攻击场景和7种LLM中评估LLM2SSRF。结果表明不同模型在易感性上存在显著差异，说明利用成功既取决于不安全的应用程序架构，也取决于模型特定行为。文章最后从提示层、模型层、应用层和网络层提出了缓解策略。本文适合Web安全研究人员、LLM应用开发者以及关注AI安全与攻防的蓝队成员阅读，有助于理解LLM集成如何扩大传统Web漏洞的触发面，并指导安全设计。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM集成应用正快速普及，而本文揭示了传统Web漏洞可通过LLM中介被重新激活，扩大了攻击面。蓝队需关注模型输出作为不可信输入，并重新评估现有WAF和防护逻辑。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有将LLM嵌入Web后端操作的场景，包括聊天机器人、自动化工具、智能体系统。攻击者可间接触发SQLi、XSS、SSRF等经典漏洞，且不同模型表现差异大，难以统一防护。
detection_signals_zh: 监控LLM生成的工具调用参数是否包含异常SQL关键字、外部URL、模板表达式或系统命令特征
对模型输出传入数据库、文件系统、网络请求等sink前进行输入校验日志记录
defense_advice_zh: 对LLM输出实施严格的输入验证和沙箱隔离，不直接信任模型生成内容
在应用层采用最小权限原则，限制工具调用可访问的资源范围
部署针对LLM中介流量的检测规则，识别模型输出中的传统攻击载荷

items.title: Withholding the Completing Chunk: Deterministic Pair-Completion Guardrails for Streaming LLM Output
items.summary: Streaming language-model output creates a release-timing problem: complete-response moderation acts after streamed text has escaped, whereas repeated semantic classification of partial text can be costly and unstable. We study a narrow deterministic construction in which each committed danger signature is the conjunction of two lexical predicates. The guard scans the accumulated prefix before every release and withholds the first chunk that makes both predicates observable. Across four signature families, eight chunk sizes, and 32 mechanism trials, streaming decisions matched the buffered scanner and withheld every pair-completing chunk; eight single-predicate controls passed. In a separate 512-trial strategy comparison, full-prefix scanning and complete buffering detected all configured pairs, a 512-character window detected 96/128, and chunk-local scanning detected 38/128. Fixed pairs flagged 0/338 human-derived safe responses and detected 0/394 jury-labelled unsafe responses, confirming narrow rather than general harm coverage. A calibrated official Llama Guard 3 1B baseline classified 310/338 safe responses as safe and 202/394 unsafe responses as unsafe. Repeated-prefix scanner time on 16,384-character responses ranged from 13.261 ms to 829.640 ms across tested chunk sizes. Pair completion is therefore an exact release-boundary backstop for a small fixed policy, not a substitute for semantic moderation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究流式大语言模型（LLM）输出中的内容审核时机问题。在流式传输场景下，完整响应的审核通常在文本全部生成后执行，但此时敏感内容已泄露给用户；而对部分文本反复进行语义分类则成本高昂且结果不稳定。为此，作者提出了一种确定性构造：每个危险签名定义为两个词法谓词的合取（即两个条件同时满足）。守卫在每次释放文本块之前扫描累积前缀，并阻止第一个使两个谓词都可被观察到的文本块释放。实验涵盖四个签名族、八种块大小和三十二次机制试验，结果显示流式决策与缓冲扫描器完全一致，且成功阻止了所有前缀补全块；八个单谓词对照实验均通过，验证了机制的精确性。在另一次五百一十二次试验的策略比较中，全前缀扫描和完全缓冲能检测所有配置的谓词对，五百一十二字符窗口检测到九十六至一百二十八例，而块本地扫描仅检测到三十八至一百二十八例，表明全局扫描的重要性。在真实数据上，固定谓词对在人类衍生的安全响应上误报为零，但对陪审团标注的不安全响应检测率为零，说明其覆盖范围狭窄，仅针对特定固定策略。校准的官方 Llama Guard 3 1B 基线将三百一十个安全响应分类为安全，但仅将两百零二个不安全响应分类为不安全，相比之下本方法更精确但泛化能力有限。性能测试显示，针对一万六千三百八十四个字符的响应，重复前缀扫描耗时在十三点二六一毫秒至八百二十九点六四零毫秒之间，具体取决于块大小。结论是：该方法是小型固定策略的精确释放边界后备机制，而非语义审核的替代品。本文适合关注流式内容安全、实时过滤和低开销审核机制的研究人员和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 流式LLM输出需要实时内容过滤，而现有语义审核存在延迟高或成本高的问题。本文提出确定性的轻量级前置过滤方法，可精确阻止特定危险模式，为安全团队提供一种可落地的补充手段。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于需要实时内容过滤的LLM服务，如聊天机器人、流式生成API；也可推广到其他需要在流式数据上执行多条件匹配的场景。
detection_signals_zh: 流式输出前缀同时满足多个预设词法条件时，立即阻止该块释放
defense_advice_zh: 作为语义审核的前置精确过滤层，优先配置高置信度的固定危险模式
结合窗口扫描或全前缀扫描以平衡性能与召回率
